facts.fact: 两人把 Maple 藏在皮包里穿过节庆人群。
facts.anchor: concealing a very small, very illegal dragon

facts.fact: Lucan 低声叮嘱幼龙藏好。
facts.anchor: “Hush, little one. You have to stay out of sight.”
The last thing we need is for the entire village to discover we’re hiding a fugitive baby dragon.

facts.fact: Maple 在 Lucan 住所四处探索。
facts.anchor: Her tiny talons click against the hardwood as she scans her new surroundings.

facts.fact: Maple 撞上吊灯后一脸无辜。
facts.anchor: She pauses midair, her head snapping toward me with an innocent blink.

facts.fact: Lucan 教 Maple 用报纸如厕。
facts.anchor: “This is where you go potty. Do you understand?”

facts.fact: 窗外是明日舞会的筹备。
facts.anchor: Through the glass, the preparations for tomorrow’s ball are unfolding.

facts.fact: Lucan 邀请 Micah 同赴王室舞会。
facts.anchor: “Will you go to the ball with me?”

facts.fact: Lucan 坚持不能让国王毁掉节日。
facts.anchor: We can’t let the king ruin this for us.
